limitations: Case-level teaching-table utility only; no scientific, privacy, image or licensing guarantee.
A source-format fit is not a scientific or origin/rights certification.
Output always uses exactly the four columns depth_m, valid, swir_group and tir_group; other source columns are not carried over.
Not an exact or row-by-row reconstruction of the source; spacing is one constant median step, so source spacing variability is not reproduced.
Classification labels are interpretations, not measured reflectance curves or physical concentrations.
Blank group labels indicate no reported classification label, not absence of physical curves.
